competency_fulfillment.rationale: Both verbs are exercised: identification through the model-reading items and representation through the shading tasks, where a child must produce 1/4, 1/2 or 1/5 on a shape rather than choose it.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The node names six denominators and one of them, sixths, is never generated in any of the nine seeds. Worse, half the pool is halves: seeds 43, 46, 500, 501 and 502 all work with 1/2, leaving thirds, fourths, fifths and eighths one appearance each.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Asking what fraction a model shows, and asking for a named unit fraction to be shaded, are both appropriately concrete for the quarter in which fractions first appear, with no symbolic manipulation demanded.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Two stems carry the entire node, one reading 'What fraction does the model show?' and one instructing the child to shade a named fraction of the shape. No number-line placement, no set-of-objects model, and no comparison of two representations occurs.

competency_alignment.rationale: Seeds 500 and 501 are the same task word for word, shading one half, inside a nine-item pool, so the generator is spending its variation budget on repetition instead of on the denominators the competency lists.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Every fraction used has a numerator of 1 and a denominator drawn from the permitted set, and the inverted decoys such as 3/1 and 8/1 stay inside the same digits rather than introducing larger denominators.
